dataset: ESA OC-CCI v6.0 chlorophyll-a (log10) and clear-sky coverage, DAILY, 0.25-degree block means of the 4 km field — family 7.2d

grid.align: point — row r is latitude -90 + 0.25 r, column c is longitude -180 + 0.25 c (family 7's g025 grid)

qc_policy: The product's only per-pixel flag is its fill value: fill, non-positive and sentinel values are not clear (they drop out of both sums and lower chl_cov). log10 is taken per 4 km cell and averaged over the block (never the log of a linear mean). NaN in both channels where no cell of the block was clear.
title: ESA OC-CCI v6.0 chlorophyll-a (log10) and clear-sky coverage, DAILY, 0.25-degree block means of the 4 km field — family 7.2d
verified: 2026-10-06: CEDA's 2015 listing and 30 days of 2015 fetched and reduced (E-087 probe: identical NaN pattern and within float16 rounding of f7l2's oc025 in every cell)
